excerpt.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，混居在我们其中的异星人开始惹是生非了。这引起了我们民众的众怒，每天都有越来越多的争斗彰显。如果坐视不理，那些异星人估计会损失惨重。
excerpt.en: The xenos living among us have begun to cause friction on [Root.GetName]. Our own people are furious, resulting in more and more fights breaking out each day. If we idly stand by the xenos might end up losing more than some bodily fluids.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，混居在我们其中的异星人开始惹是生非了。这引起了我们民众的众怒，每天都有越来越多的争斗彰显。如果坐视不理，那些异星人估计会损失惨重。
texts.en: The xenos living among us have begun to cause friction on [Root.GetName]. Our own people are furious, resulting in more and more fights breaking out each day. If we idly stand by the xenos might end up losing more than some bodily fluids.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，混居在我们其中的异星人开始惹是生非了。这引起了我们民众的众怒，每天都有越来越多的争斗彰显。如果坐视不理，那些异星人估计会损失惨重。
texts.en: The xenos living among us have begun to cause friction on [Root.GetName]. Our own people are furious, resulting in more and more fights breaking out each day. If we idly stand by the xenos might end up losing more than some bodily fluids.

texts.zh: 与其他种群共生并非易事。在[Root.GetName]星上，由于无法让外星人合理融入我方社会，一些不和悄然形成。如果仍然不采取行动，或许会产生危机。
texts.en: Having our own species living together with other lifeforms isn't always easy. Some friction has begun to take form on [Root.GetName], surely due to our inability to incorporate the aliens into our society properly. If nothing is done they might be at risk.

texts.zh: 与其他种群共生并非易事。在[Root.GetName]星上，由于无法让外星人合理融入我方社会，一些不和悄然形成。如果仍然不采取行动，或许会产生危机。
texts.en: Having our own species living together with other lifeforms isn't always easy. Some friction has begun to take form on [Root.GetName], surely due to our inability to incorporate the aliens into our society properly. If nothing is done they might be at risk.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，我们的种群和混居的其他种群产生了不和。具体原因未知，可能是因为文化区别、自我封闭或者单单的误解。但很明显，若是放任不管，这些小型冲突就会愈演愈烈。
texts.en: Having other species living with our people has caused some friction on [Root.GetName]. Be it cultural differences, xenophobia or a common misunderstanding is hard to tell, but what is sure is that these small encounters could turn to the worse if we do not intervene.

label.zh: 隔离外星人与狂躁大众。
label.en: Isolate the xenos from the mob.

label.zh: 不惜一切代价保护少数社会。
label.en: Protect the minority at any cost.
Let the xenos fight their own fight.

label.zh: 极端军国主义 · 军国主义
